text: In 1995, four-year-old Kevin and his six-year-old sister Kaylee wake in the night to find their father gone and [the windows and doors of their house disappearing|threat|evil places]. They camp downstairs with cartoons glowing on the television while the dark stays, a chair hangs upside down on the ceiling, and [a doll sits on a bedroom ceiling|images|dolls, masks and likenesses]. Then [a voice in the dark calls them upstairs|threat|something unseen], wanting to play, and [there is no way out of the house|rules|trapped with no way out].
